summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialized in the constructor and set/cleared in the run entry point's try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 8 tests covering not-running, same-thread, widget access, awaitable callables, timeout-exception propagation, variadic forwarding, exit from a background thread, and calls after stop. All 8 pass on the recorded Python 3.9 environment when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src, because the venv's textual is installed from the base checkout. Nothing committed. Pre-existing async tests fail here because pytest-asyncio is not installed; unrelated to this change.
